description: This is a PHP interface file defining the S3ClientInterface within the AWS SDK for PHP. It declares methods for interacting with Amazon S3, including creating presigned URLs, checking bucket and object existence, uploading, copying, and downloading objects, as well as region detection.

methods.name: createPresignedRequest
methods.description: Creates a pre-signed URL for a given S3 command object, allowing temporary access to an S3 resource.

methods.name: getObjectUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to an S3 object given its bucket and key.

methods.name: doesBucketExist
methods.description: Deprecated method to determine bucket existence by name.

methods.name: doesBucketExistV2
methods.description: Checks whether a bucket exists using S3's HeadBucket operation, with optional permission acceptance.

methods.name: doesObjectExist
methods.description: Deprecated method to check if an object exists.

methods.name: doesObjectExistV2
methods.description: Checks whether an object exists via the HeadObject operation, with options for considering delete markers.

methods.name: registerStreamWrapper
methods.description: Registers the Amazon S3 stream wrapper with this client.

methods.name: registerStreamWrapperV2
methods.description: Registers the Amazon S3 stream wrapper, using methods that check resource existence.

methods.name: deleteMatchingObjects
methods.description: Deletes objects from S3 matching specific criteria such as prefix or regex.

methods.name: deleteMatchingObjectsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes objects matching criteria, returning a promise.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Uploads a file, stream, or string to an S3 bucket, with multipart options.

methods.name: uploadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of upload, returns a promise.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies an object within S3, supporting multipart copy for large objects.

methods.name: copyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous copy of an S3 object, returns a promise.

methods.name: uploadDirectory
methods.description: Recursively uploads a directory's contents to an S3 bucket.

methods.name: uploadDirectoryAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous directory upload, returns a promise.

methods.name: downloadBucket
methods.description: Downloads all objects from a bucket to a local directory.

methods.name: downloadBucketAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous download of a bucket, returns a promise.

methods.name: determineBucketRegion
methods.description: Gets the region where a bucket is located.

methods.name: determineBucketRegionAsync
methods.description: Gets the bucket's region as a promise.
